lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin naam deeaa tis sevasaa tis balihaarai jaau ||
lines.translation: I serve the One who gave me the Naam; I am a sacrifice to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਢਾਹਸੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo usaare so dhaahasee tis bin avar na koi ||
lines.translation: He who builds, also demolishes; there is no other than Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਮੑਲਾ ਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee tis sa(n)mhlaa taa tan dookh na hoi ||31||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I contemplate Him, and then my body does not suffer in pain. ||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਣਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਗਹੀ ਣਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko meraa kis gahee naa ko hoaa na hog ||
lines.translation: No one is mine - whose gown should I grasp and hold? No one ever was, and no one shall ever be mine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan vigucheeai dubidhaa viaapai rog ||
lines.translation: Coming and going, one is ruined, afflicted with the disease of dual-mindedness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਣਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਆਦਮੀ ਕਲਰ ਕੰਧ ਗਿਰੰਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam vihoone aadamee kalar ka(n)dh gira(n)t ||
lines.translation: Those beings who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, collapse like pillars of salt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜਾਇ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਅੰਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai kiu chhooteeai jaai rasaatal a(n)t ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, how can they find release? They fall into hell in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵੈ ਅਖਰੀ ਅਗਣਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ganat ganaavai akharee aganat saachaa soi ||
lines.translation: Using a limited number of words, we describe the unlimited True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: agiaanee matiheen hai gur bin giaan na hoi ||
lines.translation: The ignorant lack understanding. Without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂਟੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਰਬਾਬ ਕੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tootee ta(n)t rabaab kee vaajai nahee vijog ||
lines.translation: The separated soul is like the broken string of a guitar, which does not vibrate its sound.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: vichhuRiaa melai prabhoo naanak kar sa(n)jog ||32||
lines.translation: God unites the separated souls with Himself, awakening their destiny. ||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਪੰਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਰਵਰਿ ਪੰਖੀ ਪੰਚ ॥
lines.transliteration: taravar kaaiaa pa(n)kh man taravar pa(n)khee pa(n)ch ||
lines.translation: The body is the tree, and the mind is the bird; the birds in the tree are the five senses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਸੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਰੰਚ ॥
lines.transliteration: tat chugahi mil ekase tin kau phaas na ra(n)ch ||
lines.translation: They peck at the essence of reality, and merge with the One Lord. They are never trapped at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਡਹਿ ਤ ਬੇਗੁਲ ਬੇਗੁਲੇ ਤਾਕਹਿ ਚੋਗ ਘਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: udahi ta begul begule taakahi chog ghanee ||
lines.translation: But the others fly away in a hurry, when they see the food.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਖ ਤੁਟੇ ਫਾਹੀ ਪੜੀ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਭੀੜ ਬਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)kh tute phaahee paRee avagun bheeR banee ||
lines.translation: Their feathers are clipped, and they are caught in the noose; through their mistakes, they are caught in disaster.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin saache kiu chhooteeai har gun karam manee ||
lines.translation: Without the True Lord, how can anyone find release? The jewel of the Lord's Glorious Praises comes by the karma of good actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਵਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap chhadaae chhooteeai vadaa aap dhanee ||
lines.translation: When He Himself releases them, only then are they released. He Himself is the Great Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee chhooteeai kirapaa aap karei ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, they are released, when He Himself grants His Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: apanai haath vadaaeeaa jai bhaavai tai dei ||33||
lines.translation: Glorious greatness rests in His Hands. He blesses those with whom He is pleased. ||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਰ ਥਰ ਕੰਪੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਥਾਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: thar thar ka(n)pai jeeaRaa thaan vihoonaa hoi ||
lines.translation: The soul trembles and shakes, when it loses its mooring and support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਫੀਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaan maan sach ek hai kaaj na pheetai koi ||
lines.translation: Only the support of the True Lord brings honor and glory. Through it, one's works are never in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: thir naaraain thir guroo thir saachaa beechaar ||
lines.translation: The Lord is eternal and forever stable; the Guru is stable, and contemplation upon the True Lord is stable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥੁ ਤੂ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sur nar naathah naath too nidhaaraa aadhaar ||
lines.translation: O Lord and Master of angels, men and Yogic masters, You are the support of the unsupported.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰੀ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarabe thaan thana(n)taree too daataa daataar ||
lines.translation: In all places and interspaces, You are the Giver, the Great Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah dekhaa tah ek too a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, there I see You, Lord; You have no end or limitation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa gurasabadee veechaar ||
lines.translation: You are pervading and permeating the places and interspaces; reflecting upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਵਡਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: anama(n)giaa daan devasee vadaa agam apaar ||34||
lines.translation: You give gifts even when they are not asked for; You are great, inaccessible and infinite. ||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa daan daiaal too kar kar dekhanahaar ||
lines.translation: O Merciful Lord, You are the embodiment of mercy; creating the Creation, You behold it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa karahi prabh mel laihi khin mahi dhaahi usaar ||
lines.translation: Please shower Your Mercy upon me, O God, and unite me with Yourself. In an instant, You destroy and rebuild.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: daanaa too beenaa tuhee daanaa kai sir daan ||
lines.translation: You are all-wise and all-seeing; You are the Greatest Giver of all givers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਲਦ ਭੰਜਨ ਦੁਖ ਦਲਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: daalad bha(n)jan dukh dalan guramukh giaan dhiaan ||35||
lines.translation: He is the Eradicator of poverty, and the Destroyer of pain; the Gurmukh realizes spiritual wisdom and meditation. ||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਗਇਐ ਬਹਿ ਝੂਰੀਐ ਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਤੁ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan gaiai bahi jhooreeai dhan mahi cheet gavaar ||
lines.translation: Losing his wealth, he cries out in anguish; the fool's consciousness is engrossed in wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan viralee sach sa(n)chiaa niramal naam piaar ||
lines.translation: How rare are those who gather the wealth of Truth, and love the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਾ ਜਾਣ ਦੇਹਿ ਜੇ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan gaiaa taa jaan dehi je raachahi ra(n)g ek ||
lines.translation: If by losing your wealth, you may become absorbed in the Love of the One Lord, then just let it go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਉਪੀਐ ਭੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: man deejai sir saupeeai bhee karate kee tek ||
lines.translation: Dedicate your mind, and surrender your head; seek only the Support of the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)dhaa dhaavat rahi gae man mahi sabad ana(n)d ||
lines.translation: Worldly affairs and wanderings cease, when the mind is filled with the bliss of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਤੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਭਏ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: durajan te saajan bhae bhete gur govi(n)d ||
lines.translation: Even one's enemies become friends, meeting with the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਫਿਰਤੀ ਢੂਢਤੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ban ban phiratee dhoodhatee basat rahee ghar baar ||
lines.translation: Wandering from forest to forest searching, you will find that those things are within the home of your own heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: satigur melee mil rahee janam maran dukh nivaar ||36||
lines.translation: United by the True Guru, you shall remain united, and the pains of birth and death will be ended. ||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanaa karat na chhooteeai vin gun jam pur jaahi ||
lines.translation: Through various rituals, one does not find release. Without virtue, one is sent to the City of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਓਹੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa tis ehu na ohu hai avagun phir pachhutaahi ||
lines.translation: One will not have this world or the next; committing sinful mistakes, one comes to regret and repent in the end.
